Senior Full Stack Engineer
Voronka Systems
Kyiv · Hybrid
$5000–6000

Voronka Systems builds a logistics marketplace that connects 4,000 carriers across Eastern Europe.

What you'll do
- Ship features end to end in React and Node.js
- Design PostgreSQL schemas and write efficient queries
- Review code and mentor two engineers

What we look for
- 5+ years of full stack development
- TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express
- PostgreSQL, Redis
- Docker
- Fluent English
